description.zh: 把问题交给已连接的编程代理，并在工作区里协作。
description.en: Hand each task to a connected coding agent and work in this directory.

description.zh: 根据现象定位并改到通过
description.en: Find the cause and make it pass

prompt.zh: 请在当前工作区修这个问题。先复现或定位原因，再做最小改动，并说明如何验证：
prompt.en: Fix this in the current workspace. Find the cause first, then make the smallest change, and say how to verify it:

description.zh: 按现有结构把功能做进去
description.en: Fit the feature into the current structure

prompt.zh: 请在当前工作区实现下面的功能。先看相关代码再改，保持现有风格，并说明改动范围：
prompt.en: Implement this feature in the current workspace. Read the related code first, match the existing style, and summarize what changed:

description.zh: 讲清它做什么、数据怎么走
description.en: What it does and how data moves

prompt.zh: 请阅读当前工作区里下面这些代码，说明它做什么、关键调用链，以及容易改错的地方：
prompt.en: Read this code in the current workspace. Explain what it does, the main call path, and what is easy to get wrong:

prompt.zh: 请审查当前工作区里的这次改动。指出正确性、回归风险和遗漏的测试，不要泛泛而谈：
prompt.en: Review the change in the current workspace. Call out correctness, regression risk, and missing tests. Be specific:

description.zh: 给关键路径补上能跑的测试
description.en: Cover the important path with a test that runs

prompt.zh: 请为下面的行为补测试。先看现有测试怎么写，再补能失败也能通过的用例，并跑一下：
prompt.en: Add tests for this behavior. Follow the existing tests, cover a case that can fail, and run them:

description.zh: 让结构更清楚，行为保持不变
description.en: Clarify the structure without changing behavior

prompt.zh: 请整理下面这块代码，让它更好读，但不要改变对外行为。改完说明动了哪里，以及你怎么确认行为没变：
prompt.en: Refactor this code so it is easier to follow, without changing observable behavior. Say what moved and how you checked:
